not_proven.detail: Ordering on shared ACCTDATA and TCATBALF is not proven between the monthly folder and the separate CA7 CARDDEMO table.
Online update exclusion is not proven: CLOSEFIL/OPENFIL SDSF runtime effects are opaque; scheduled close/open names do not prove quiescence.

Both have JOBISN=4. WAITSTEP OUTCOND and OPENFIL INCOND prove a condition edge; this is the only explicit ordering mechanism between them in the supplied folder. Import/runtime behavior with duplicate identifiers remains unproven.
Ordering is not proven between INTCALC reading DISCGRP and DisclosureGroupsRefresh deleting, redefining and loading it; the weekly folder conditions do not name the monthly folder.

No cross-folder trigger into or out of the monthly folder appears in the supplied Control-M export: its INCOND/OUTCOND names are internal. External production triggers or cross-scheduler dependencies are not proven absent.
